title: Deus nobis haec otia fecit
html_source:
Publius Vergilius Maro (October 15, 70 BC – September 21, 19 BC), known in English as Virgil
Eclogues (37 BC)

Deus nobis haec otia fecit.
God has given us this ease.
Book I, line 6.

Variant translations:
God gave us this leisure.
God hath given us this tranquillity.
